title: [AI Post Maker][V1] MVP End-to-End Flow
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Deliver the V1 MVP end-to-end flow described in agents.md with working generation, captioning, UI visibility, and manual sharing.

Scope:
- In scope: prompt submission, image generation via local ComfyUI, caption generation, UI updates, manual sharing actions, and CI parity.
- Out of scope: scheduling, automation, Instagram API posting, billing, token usage, multi-provider optimization.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A signed-in user can submit a prompt, see status progress (queue -> running -> completed/failed), receive a ComfyUI-generated image + caption, and use manual share actions.
- Failures surface clearly in UI and do not leave stale states.
- CI workflows pass on main for lint and tests.

Technical Notes:
- Image generation uses a local ComfyUI instance over HTTP (http://localhost:8188); jobs are queued, polled for status (queue -> running -> completed/failed), and output images are retrieved and attached to the Post (ActiveStorage).
- Primary areas: app/controllers/home_controller.rb, app/jobs/*.rb, app/services/*.rb, app/components/**/*, app/javascript/controllers/*, config/routes.rb.

Tests:
- Controller/job/service tests updated or added per child tickets.
- Any UI refresh mechanisms covered by request/system tests where feasible.

Definition of Done:
- All child tickets completed and validated; CI green.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Caption] Implement local caption generation
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Caption generation is currently a local stub and does not produce real captions, so the V1 caption requirement is unmet.

Scope:
- In scope: implement local caption generation, parse output into variants, handle errors, and wire any local config.
- Out of scope: multi-caption selection UI (V2), provider fallback (V2), billing or token usage (V3).

Acceptance Criteria:
- When caption generation runs, GenerateCaptionJob persists a locally generated caption on the Post.
- Errors from caption generation are caught and stored in post.data["caption_error"] without crashing the job.
- README/.env.example document any optional local caption settings (no external keys).

Technical Notes:
- Update app/services/local_caption_service.rb (or equivalent) to generate captions locally.
- Update tests: test/services/local_caption_service_test.rb, test/jobs/generate_caption_job_test.rb.

Tests:
- Service unit tests for success + error paths using local stubs (or equivalent).
- Job test ensures caption persists and errors are stored without raising.

Definition of Done:
- Local caption generation integrated, tests passing, and docs updated.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Dashboard] Live job status refresh
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Job status and caption/image completion are not reflected in the UI until manual refresh; poller controller exists but is unused.

Scope:
- In scope: add a turbo-stream endpoint to refresh the dashboard panel and wire the poller controller to call it.
- Out of scope: real-time websockets, multi-user activity feeds, analytics dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- While a job is queue/running, the right panel auto-refreshes and shows updated status, caption, and ComfyUI image asset when ready.
- The poller is lightweight and only updates the dashboard frame.
- No manual refresh is required to see completed/failed states.

Technical Notes:
- Add a route + controller action (e.g., HomeController#dashboard_jobs) that renders turbo_stream.replace("dashboard_jobs", Dashboard::RightPanelComponent).
- Wire data-controller="poller" and data-poller-url-value on the dashboard container (app/views/home/index.rb or component).
- Consider a small interval (e.g., 5s) and ensure it stops on disconnect.

Tests:
- Request/controller test for the new turbo-stream endpoint.
- Optional system test to assert the dashboard updates after job completion (if feasible).

Definition of Done:
- Dashboard auto-refresh is wired and verified; tests passing.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Auth] Scope prompts/posts to current user
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Prompts and posts are not tied to a user; any signed-in user can see/delete others' content.

Scope:
- In scope: add user ownership to prompts/posts/assets and scope queries and controllers to current_user.
- Out of scope: team accounts, sharing posts across users, admin dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Each prompt/post belongs to a user and is only visible/manageable by that user.
- Home dashboard lists only the current user's posts.
- Deleting a post does not affect other users' data.

Technical Notes:
- Add user_id to prompts (or posts) via migration; update associations in app/models/prompt.rb, app/models/post.rb, app/models/user.rb.
- Scope HomeController queries and PostsController lookups by current_user.
- Update fixtures and tests: test/fixtures/prompts.yml, test/fixtures/posts.yml, test/controllers/*.

Tests:
- Controller tests for scoping (home index and destroy/cancel only access owned records).
- Model association tests for user ownership.

Definition of Done:
- User data is isolated across the app; tests updated and passing.
- Size: L.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Caption] Surface caption errors in UI
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Caption generation failures are stored in post.data["caption_error"] but never surfaced in the UI, leaving users without feedback.

Scope:
- In scope: display caption generation errors in dashboard cards when caption is missing and caption_error exists.
- Out of scope: retry UX, multi-caption selection (V2), analytics.

Acceptance Criteria:
- If caption generation fails, the dashboard shows a clear, localized error message on the job card.
- Error display does not affect successful captions.

Technical Notes:
- Extend DashboardJob to expose caption_error.
- Update app/components/dashboard/* to render caption error state.
- Add i18n copy under config/locales/*.yml if needed.

Tests:
- Model test for DashboardJob mappings.
- View/component test if available, or controller test that renders error text.

Definition of Done:
- Caption errors are visible in UI and covered by tests.
- Size: S.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Prompt] Resolve lang/tone fields
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Prompt fields lang/tone exist in the model and job but are not exposed in the UI, causing hidden defaults and unused data paths.

Scope:
- In scope: decide to expose lang/tone controls in the prompt form or remove the fields from the flow.
- Out of scope: multi-caption selection (V2), localization system changes.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Either:
  - UI exposes lang/tone with sensible defaults and persists values; or
  - lang/tone are removed from prompt params + service inputs if intentionally not used.
- Decision is documented in README or inline notes.

Technical Notes:
- app/components/panels/create_panel_component.rb
- app/controllers/home_controller.rb (prompt_params)
- app/jobs/generate_caption_job.rb and app/services/local_caption_service.rb
- db/migrate/* if removing columns (optional path)

Tests:
- Controller tests for permitted params if UI is added.
- Service/job tests updated for new/default behavior.

Definition of Done:
- Prompt fields are either user-controllable or removed; tests updated.
- Size: S.

Definition of Done:

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][Schedule] Scheduled posts
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- V2 roadmap requires scheduling posts; current code has scheduled_at/published_at fields but no scheduling workflow.

Scope:
- In scope: schedule a post for a future time, persist scheduled_at, and run a job at that time to mark as ready for manual share.
- Out of scope: automatic posting to Instagram, reminder notifications, billing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can set a scheduled time for a post.
- Scheduled posts appear with a "scheduled" state until time arrives.
- At scheduled time, the post becomes available for manual sharing.

Technical Notes:
- Likely changes: app/models/post.rb, app/jobs/* (new scheduler job), app/components/* for UI, config/recurring.yml (if using recurring jobs).

Tests:
- Model validation tests for scheduled_at.
- Job test for scheduled publish transition.

Definition of Done:
- Scheduling workflow implemented end-to-end with tests.
- Size: L.

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][Caption] Multiple caption variants
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- V2 roadmap includes multiple captions per post; currently only one caption is stored and displayed.

Scope:
- In scope: store multiple caption variants per post and allow selecting the active caption.
- Out of scope: Gemini provider changes beyond V1 integration, analytics.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Users can view caption variants and choose which one is active.
- Selected caption persists on Post and is used for copy/share actions.

Technical Notes:
- Use existing post.data["caption_variants"] and caption_selected_index from GenerateCaptionJob.
- Update UI components (app/components/dashboard/*) to display selectable variants.
- Consider a small Turbo interaction for selection.

Tests:
- Model/service tests for caption selection persistence.
- UI/controller test for selection action.

Definition of Done:
- Caption variants are visible and selectable, with tests.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][Generation] Provider fallback & retries
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- V2 roadmap requires provider fallback & retries to improve generation reliability; current flow uses only AI Horde.

Scope:
- In scope: retry strategy for transient failures and optional fallback provider for image generation.
- Out of scope: paid provider tiers, advanced rate limiting (V3).

Acceptance Criteria:
- On transient errors, image generation retries a limited number of times.
- If configured, a fallback provider can be used after primary failure.

Technical Notes:
- Update app/jobs/generate_image_job.rb to handle retries/fallback decisions.
- Extend app/services/ai_horde_image_service.rb or add a new provider service wrapper.
- Configuration via ENV for retry count and fallback provider.

Tests:
- Job tests for retry path and fallback path (stubbed services).
- Service tests for error classification.

Definition of Done:
- Fallback/retry behavior implemented and tested.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][Analytics] Basic dashboard metrics

Technical Notes:

- Update app/components/dashboard/* to display metrics.

Tests:

Definition of Done:

- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][UX] Dashboard polish

- Size: S.

title: [AI Post Maker][V2][Caption] Add Gemini provider (optional upgrade)
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- V2 optional upgrade should allow Gemini captions for users with a paid key while keeping V1 free provider intact.

Scope:
- In scope: add CAPTION_PROVIDER=gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY.
- Keep V1 openrouter/template caption paths unchanged.
- Record provider errors in post.data["caption_error"] without crashing the job.

Out of scope:
- Changes to free provider behavior.
- Multiple caption variants (separate V2 ticket).

Acceptance Criteria:
- With CAPTION_PROVIDER=gemini and GEMINI_API_KEY configured, captions are generated via Gemini.
- Missing/invalid Gemini key stores an error in post.data["caption_error"] and the job continues.
- V1 openrouter/template behavior remains intact.

Technical Notes:
- Add/restore a Gemini caption service and wire into provider selection.
- Configure GEMINI_API_KEY in env docs (V2 only).
- Tests use Faraday stubs for Gemini responses.

Tests:
- Service tests for Gemini success + error using Faraday stubs.
- Job test ensures errors are stored without crash.

Definition of Done:
- Gemini provider works as an optional upgrade; tests passing.
- Size: S.
